x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      V1G or V2B or V2G or V2H or stemmed "EV fleet"
      or stemmed "electric vehicle" or stemmed "smart charging"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-building" or stemmed "vehicle-to-grid"
      or stemmed "vehicle-to-home"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "carbon-aware"
      or stemmed "clean energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable integration"
      or curtailment
    )
  )
